name: Freshchat
description: Freshchat is Freshworks' customer-messaging platform for support conversations, routing, agents, groups, channels, bots, and outbound engagement.
agentUseSummary: Enter one Freshchat account URL and customer-generated API key, then let selected agents use content-free conversation operations or approved documented API v2 requests under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: FRESHCHAT_ACCOUNT_URL
credentialRequirements.label: Freshchat account URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the HTTPS chat account host shown by Freshchat, ending in .freshchat.com or .myfreshworks.com; omit resource paths.

credentialRequirements.name: FRESHCHAT_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Freshchat API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate an API token in Freshchat admin settings. Relay sends it only as a bearer credential to the exact account host.

capabilities.label: Read conversation operations
capabilities.description: Read one exact conversation and bounded message metadata without message content, reply parts, attachments, user profiles, contact details, or custom properties.

capabilities.label: Freshchat API v2
capabilities.description: Use documented API v2 operations allowed by the connected Freshchat account API key.

approvalRequired.label: Read conversation metadata
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact Freshchat conversation through Relay's content-free operational projection.

approvalRequired.label: List message metadata
approvalRequired.description: List one fixed first page of content-free message metadata for one exact conversation.

approvalRequired.label: Use Freshchat API v2
approvalRequired.description: Use a documented Freshchat API v2 operation authorized by the connected account API key; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Content-free conversation reads and every broader API operation require approval; tenant binding, secret isolation, provider authorization, and limits remain enforced.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected API-key-authorized operations run without Relay per-action approval; exact tenant binding, secret isolation, request bounds, audits, provider authorization, and Freshchat limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted API key only to the exact normalized Freshchat account origin.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted API key only to the exact normalized Freshchat account origin.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer Freshchat account URL and admin-generated API key are required for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer enters the exact Freshchat chat account URL and API key, then Relay verifies account health, content-free reads, Safe approval, Dangerous broader API behavior, token reset, and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Freshchat's official API reference documents customer-generated API tokens, bearer authentication, token lifetime, and the account-specific freshchat.com or retrieved myfreshworks.com chat URL.
Freshchat documents API v2 conversation retrieval, conversation updates, bounded paginated message listing, message sends, and the corresponding OAuth permissions.
Freshchat documents the account-configuration endpoint used for exact-account health verification and account metadata.
